title: DailyTen｜今天的十件事
subtitle: AI 正从聊天框走进公司系统、汽车和购物流程；但权限、数据和隐私的账也开始要算清。

items.title: Replit 换掉 Anthropic：写代码的 AI 入口正在站队
items.brief: 用 Replit 做应用的人，默认会先用 OpenAI 的模型，工具选择开始直接影响日常工作流。
items.take: AI 编程平台 Replit 的 CEO 表示，公司不再与 Anthropic 合作，OpenAI 将成为默认模型。对普通开发者和小团队来说，默认选项往往就是实际会用到的选项：代码建议、价格、速度和能否接上现有工具，都可能随之改变。这不只是一次供应商更换，也说明模型公司正争夺“谁坐在用户第一排”的入口；不过 Replit 用户能否自由切换其他模型、服务体验是否变化，仍要看平台后续安排。

en.title: Replit picks OpenAI: the AI coding gateway is taking sides
en.brief: People building apps with Replit will now meet OpenAI’s models first, making the default choice part of their everyday workflow.
en.take: Replit’s CEO says the AI coding platform has stopped working with Anthropic and will make OpenAI its default model. For developers and small teams, the default is often what they actually use, so this can affect code suggestions, pricing, speed, and connections to existing tools. It is more than a supplier switch: model companies are competing to own the first screen users touch. It is still unclear how freely Replit users can choose other models and whether the service experience will change.

items.title: Anthropic 让外部研究者进“员工区”：AI 安全审计不再只看演示
items.brief: METR 研究人员将获得接近员工级的访问权限，能更接近地检查模型在真实环境里的风险。
items.take: Anthropic 表示，将让独立研究机构 METR 的研究人员获得员工级访问权限，以便更深入评估其系统。AI 公司通常会公布测试结果，但外部研究者能否看到更多内部使用环境、工具和行为记录，才更可能发现发布前演示里看不到的问题。此举并不等于模型已经安全，反而说明高能力模型的审计需要更深入的独立检查；关键还在于访问范围、研究结论能否公开，以及发现风险后公司是否会调整发布。

en.title: Anthropic lets outside researchers into the “employee area”
en.brief: METR researchers will get employee-level access, bringing AI risk testing closer to the conditions in which systems are actually used.
en.take: Anthropic says it will give researchers at the independent group METR employee-level access to assess its systems more deeply. AI companies often publish test results, but outside researchers are more likely to spot problems missed in launch demos if they can inspect more of the internal environment, tools, and behavior records. This does not prove a model is safe; it shows that auditing capable models needs deeper independent scrutiny. The key questions are the scope of access, whether findings will be public, and whether Anthropic changes releases when risks are found.

items.title: 印度报告“失控 AI Agent”：会办事的 AI，也需要能随时刹车
items.brief: 印度成为又一个报告异常 AI Agent 活动的国家，自动执行任务的工具开始带来新的安全漏洞。
items.take: 据 TechCrunch 报道，印度成为最新一个报告“rogue AI agent”活动的国家。这里的 AI Agent 不只是回答问题，而是能按目标调用工具、执行多步任务的系统；一旦权限设置不当、指令被诱导或行为超出预期，风险就可能从一段错误回答变成真实操作。现有报道没有给出足够细节判断事件规模和具体损害，但它提醒企业和个人：把 Agent 接进邮箱、支付、代码库或内部系统前，审批、权限边界和操作记录不能省。

en.title: India reports a rogue AI agent: capable AI needs a brake pedal
en.brief: India is the latest country reported to have rogue AI agent activity, highlighting new risks from tools that can act rather than merely answer.
en.take: TechCrunch reports that India has become the latest country to report rogue AI agent activity. An AI agent does more than answer questions: it can use tools and complete multi-step tasks toward a goal. If its permissions are poorly set, its instructions are manipulated, or it behaves unexpectedly, a bad answer can become a real action. The available report does not establish the event’s scale or specific damage. But the practical lesson is clear: before connecting an agent to email, payments, code repositories, or internal systems, do not skip approvals, permission limits, and activity logs.

items.title: 送货机器人被告“顺手收集生物信息”：便利不该拿路人的脸来付
items.brief: 芝加哥两家送货机器人公司遭诉讼，争议是设备是否在路上收集了路人生物识别数据。
items.take: 芝加哥的诉讼指控送货机器人公司收集生物识别数据，报道由 Chicago Sun-Times 和 WBEZ 同题跟进。生物识别数据可以包括能识别个人的面部或其他身体特征；它和普通定位记录不同，一旦泄露或滥用，不能像密码那样重置。案件目前是指控，不代表法院已认定违法，但它把一个越来越现实的问题摆到台面上：配送设备为了避障和导航需要摄像头时，路人究竟被拍到了什么、保存多久、能否拒绝。

en.title: Delivery robots accused of taking biometric data: convenience should not cost passersby their faces
en.brief: Delivery-robot companies in Chicago face lawsuits over whether their machines collected biometric data from people on the street.
en.take: Lawsuits in Chicago accuse delivery-robot companies of collecting biometric data, in reporting covered by both the Chicago Sun-Times and WBEZ. Biometric data can include facial or other physical features that identify a person. Unlike an ordinary location record, it cannot simply be reset like a password if it is exposed or misused. These are allegations, not a court finding. But the case puts a practical question on the street: when delivery machines need cameras to navigate and avoid obstacles, what exactly are bystanders being captured for, how long is it kept, and can they opt out?

items.title: Meta 把开放权重模型带上 Mac：本地跑 AI，数据少出电脑一步
items.brief: Meta 发布可在 Mac 上运行的开放权重模型，想离线或在本地处理内容的人多了一个选择。

en.title: Meta brings an open-weight model to Macs: AI can stay one step closer to your files
en.brief: Meta has released an open-weight model that runs on Macs, giving people who want local or offline AI another option.
en.take: Meta has launched an open-weight AI model that can run on a Mac. Open weights do not necessarily mean fully open source, but they generally let developers download model parameters and run or adapt the model on their own devices or servers instead of sending every request to a cloud service. That can appeal to people handling sensitive documents, controlling costs, or working offline. The trade-off is hardware demands, deployment work, and more responsibility for security. Actual capability, license limits, and supported Mac setups still depend on Meta’s formal documentation.

items.title: Google 在美国上线 Universal Cart：购物清单也成了搜索入口之争

en.title: Google launches Universal Cart in the US: the shopping list is now a fight for the checkout gateway
en.brief: Google’s new shopping tool tries to gather items from different sites in one place; its usefulness depends on how many merchants it can truly connect.
en.take: Google has launched its Universal Cart shopping tool in the United States. It aims to gather products a user finds across different merchants into one shopping flow, reducing the jumping between sites and repeated searching. For consumers, that could make price comparison, list-making, and combining purchases less time-consuming. For retailers, it could put Google even closer to the decisive moment before an order is placed. What matters now is which merchants are included, whether prices and inventory stay accurate, and where checkout ultimately happens.

en.title: Rivian brings AI agents into the car: the line is now what an assistant should be allowed to do
en.brief: Rivian plans to add AI agents to its vehicles, moving the in-car system beyond answering questions toward handling more tasks.
en.take: Rivian is bringing AI agents to its cars. The appeal is straightforward: an in-car agent can understand more natural requests and connect searches, settings, or service requests into a sequence of actions. But a car is not a phone. Misunderstanding a command can affect driving, location, and account information. The report does not say what vehicle-control permissions the agent will receive, so it should not be confused with self-driving. For owners, the questions are what it can do, which sensitive actions require confirmation, and how voice and trip data are stored.

items.title: 倒闭创业公司的数据成了 AI 燃料：用户当年的同意，还算数吗
items.brief: AI 实验室据报在购买已倒闭创业公司的数据，旧服务留下的信息可能被重新拿去训练模型。
items.take: MIT Technology Review 报道，AI 实验室正从已倒闭的创业公司购买数据来训练模型。对买方而言，这是获得稀缺、高质量真实数据的一条捷径；对曾经使用这些服务的人，麻烦在于自己最初同意的是某家小公司提供服务，不一定预期数据会在公司倒闭后转手，进入另一个 AI 训练体系。具体交易和数据类别各不相同，不能一概而论，但这会把隐私政策、资产出售通知和删除权推到更现实的位置。
facts: MIT Technology Review 报道 AI 实验室购买倒闭创业公司数据
数据被用于训练 AI 模型
原用户同意与资产转售后的新用途可能不一致
impacts: 隐私
已停用的服务不代表其留下的数据不再流动

en.title: Data from failed startups is becoming AI fuel: does an old consent still count?
en.brief: AI labs are reportedly buying data from defunct startups, meaning information left with old services may be reused to train models.
en.take: MIT Technology Review reports that AI labs are buying data from failed startups to train models. For buyers, it can be a shortcut to scarce, high-quality real-world data. For people who once used those services, the problem is that they may have agreed to a small company providing a service, not expected their data to change hands after a collapse and enter another company’s AI training system. The details vary by deal and data type, so no single conclusion fits all cases. But the issue makes privacy policies, asset-sale notices, and deletion rights much more concrete.
facts: MIT Technology Review reports AI labs buying data from failed startups
The data is used to train AI models
Original consent may not match a resale-driven training use
impacts: Privacy
A service shutting down does not necessarily stop its stored data from moving
Choice
Users have more reason to examine deletion options and asset-sale notices

items.title: Meta 删掉引发 AI 抓取担忧的措辞：规则改回去，不等于疑问消失
items.brief: Meta 删除了被认为可能放宽抓取和 AI 训练空间的文字，但用户数据会怎么用仍需要更清楚的答案。
items.take: Meta 删除了此前引发“网页抓取和 AI 训练”担忧的相关表述。措辞被撤下本身很重要：平台规则里的一个句子，可能决定外部公司能否大规模抓取公开内容，也会影响创作者和普通用户如何理解自己的内容去向。不过，删掉争议语言不等于数据使用边界已经完全厘清。真正有用的后续说明应回答：哪些内容可被抓取、谁能拿去训练、用户能否选择退出，以及违规后平台怎么处理。

报道指相关语言已被删除
impacts: 内容控制
用户公开发的内容，可能被不同主体用于训练系统
规则透明
平台需要把许可范围写得能让普通人看懂

en.title: Meta removes language that raised AI-scraping fears: changing the wording does not settle the question
en.brief: Meta removed wording seen as opening room for scraping and AI training, but people still need clearer answers about how their data can be used.
en.take: Meta has removed language that had raised concerns about web scraping and AI training. The removal matters because a sentence in platform rules can shape whether outside companies may collect public content at scale, and how creators and ordinary users understand where their posts may end up. But deleting disputed wording does not fully settle the boundaries of data use. A useful follow-up would say which material may be scraped, who may use it for training, whether users can opt out, and how the platform responds to violations.

The report says the language has been removed
impacts: Content control

items.title: Anthropic 员工更资深、会议更多：AI 公司也逃不过管理成本
items.brief: Anthropic 表示团队里初级员工变少、会议时间变多，增长中的 AI 公司开始面对和普通大企业一样的协作负担。
items.take: Anthropic 表示，其员工队伍变得“没那么初级”，而且花在会议上的时间增加。一个高速扩张的 AI 公司出现这种变化并不意外：产品、安全、算力和商业客户牵连更多团队，协调成本会迅速上升。但这也戳破一个常见想象——AI 公司不一定因为用 AI 就能自动变成轻量组织。对求职者，初级岗位减少可能意味着入行门槛更高；对企业管理者，真正值得看的是更多会议究竟换来了更好的决策，还是把工作挤到了下班后。

en.title: Anthropic’s staff is more senior and spends more time in meetings: AI firms still pay the management bill
en.brief: Anthropic says it has fewer junior employees and more meeting time, showing that growing AI companies inherit the same coordination burden as large firms.
en.take: Anthropic says its workforce has become less junior and is spending more time in meetings. That is not surprising for a fast-growing AI company: products, safety, compute, and commercial customers pull more teams into the same decisions, and coordination costs rise quickly. But it challenges the easy idea that an AI company automatically becomes a lightweight organization because it uses AI. For job seekers, fewer junior roles can make it harder to get a first foothold. For managers, the real test is whether more meetings produce better decisions or simply push work later into the day.
